Alex Rivera: Quick sync: INC-912 postmortem action items — who picks up which items? Need owners + due dates by EOD so we can close the incident ticket.

Maria Chen: I can take 'slow KV cache flush on dedicated' — will debug root cause and propose fix. ETA Wed EOD. Assign to Maria Chen. I'll open PR when I have repro steps.

Sam Patel: I'll own 'graceful fallback to small-model' rollback config and rollout policy. PR #4526 needed. Target Mon 2024-03-11 for canary. Sam Patel :thumbsup: 

Jordan Lee: I can handle 'observability gap for token-level tracing' — but need data retention increase from infra. Jordan Lee -> can we get retention bumped to 30d? @Priya Singh

Priya Singh: On infra retention — we can add extra 30d for the index, but need approval from infra lead. I'll queue a change and tag infra-leads. ETA Tue EOD. Priya Singh

Alex Rivera: Two cross-team deps: (a) model-team to verify quantization profile doesn't regress (b) billing needs to accept revised tokenization metric. @Maria Chen can you chase model-team? @Sam Patel ping billing.

Maria Chen: Yep. Opening ticket to model-team now: MODEL-284. Will add repro artifacts and signal regression tests. Maria Chen

Sam Patel: Billing pinged (#ticket BILL-99). They're ok with metric change but need an example mapping. I'll attach one to the PR.

Oncall Bot: Incident INC-912 postmortem created: https://redwood.link/inc/912. Reminder: action owners please add due date in the ticket.

Alex Rivera: Putting a quick action table here — please confirm by replying with :+1: and exact ISO due date (YYYY-MM-DD):
```
Item: Slow KV cache flush on Dedicated
Owner: Maria Chen
Due: 2024-03-13

Item: Fallback rollback & canary policy
Owner: Sam Patel
Due: 2024-03-11

Item: Token-level tracing retention
Owner: Jordan Lee / Infra
Due: 2024-03-12

Item: Quantization regression tests
Owner: Model Team (cc Maria Chen)
Due: 2024-03-14
```

Maria Chen: :thumbsup: Confirmed. Due 2024-03-13. I'll link MODEL-284.

Sam Patel: :+1: Confirmed. Due 2024-03-11. PR #4526 will include mapping for billing.

Jordan Lee: :eyes: I need infra lead signoff. Tentative due 2024-03-12. @Priya Singh will follow up.

Priya Singh: :white_check_mark: Infra lead approved the retention bump. Setting infra change for 2024-03-10. Jordan Lee, that should unblock you earlier.

Alex Rivera: Thanks. Two followups: Maria — add a checklist in MODEL-284 for regression evals. Sam — set canary to 10% traffic for 24h then 50% if stable. Jordan — update the observability dashboard to include token tracing metric (dash id: dash-77).

Maria Chen: Will do checklist + attach eval prompts.

Sam Patel: Will add canary steps & alerting thresholds in PR.

Jordan Lee: I'll update dash-77 and post a screenshot in the ticket.

Alex Rivera: Perfect. If anything slips past due, ping me and we'll reassign. Closing the loop here — thanks everyone :rocket:
